description: Land Acquisition - Amended Extraordinary Gazette No. 2320/86 on 25th of February 2023, Ambagamuwa D/S Division, Ginigathhena - Pethiyagoda, Kelaniya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically providing detailed notices about the government's intention to acquire multiple plots of land for public purposes. It contains extensive descriptions of land parcels, including their locations, boundaries, assessments, uses, and claimants. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
